descriptions: Unleash full immersion with the Razer BlackWidow V4 Pro 75% - US INTL - Wireless, Hot-Swap Keyboard powered by Razer HyperSpeed ​​and 4K Hz HyperPolling. The keyboard's circuit board is compatible with 3 or 5-pin switches, allowing you to easily swap out the pre-installed switches for your own to achieve the key feel you want. OLED display with Razer Dial command selector for maximum control and customizability
From checking your PC's system metrics to customizing your display to show custom GIFs, expand your control with up to 100 customizable modes with the Razer Command Dial.
Optimized typing experience with enthusiast-level typing acoustics

With a gasket-mounted FR4 board, an improved circuit board, lubricated screw stabilizers, and two layers of sound-dampening foam, you'll enjoy a clean sound and typing feel with minimal rattling or wobbling. With a soft, cushioned wrist rest that securely attaches to the keyboard, enjoy long-lasting comfort that will help you get through the most intense gaming marathons.
Textured Doubleshot PBT keycaps for increased durability and RGB shine
Stronger and more durable than ABS, the non-fade keycaps maintain a matte, textured finish and are optimized to support better backlighting.

SteelSeries Alias Pro - EMEA.description: Microphone - desktop, suitable for PC, streaming, gaming communication, condenser, directional pickup, frequency from 50 to 20,000 Hz, sensitivity 120 dB, Mute button and Volume control, headphone output, stand and cable included
descriptions: The SteelSeries Alias Pro gaming microphone uses a 3x larger capsule (25 mm) than regular microphones, thanks to which it can capture a wide range of sounds. The microphone was designed to be connected to two PCs at the same time. With the Sonar for Streamers software solution, you can easily adjust your sound like a pro. SteelSeries Alias ​​Pro uses artificial intelligence-assisted ambient noise cancellation. The microphone comes with a Stream Mixer, where you can easily mute the sound and microphone, or adjust the volume. In addition, you will definitely appreciate the stylish RGB backlighting of the Stream Mixer. A robust shock mount will prevent unwanted sound from getting into your stream.
Key Features of the SteelSeries Alias Pro Microphone

• The ideal microphone for gaming and streaming
  • SteelSeries Alias Pro has a 1" capsule for accurate sound capture
  • Includes a Stream Mixer with mappable controls and RGB lighting that connects to the microphone via an XLR cable
  • AI-powered noise cancellation ensures sound clarity
  • The robust shock mount prevents the transmission of unwanted sounds such as typing on the keyboard, etc.
  • Connecting via USB-C (Stream Mixer to PC)
  • 2× USB-C for connecting to two PCs simultaneously
  • Possibility to connect headphones for real-time monitoring
  • Flexible design
Easy audio editing in Sonar and XLR Stream Mixer

First, you select your device and set Sonar Stream as the only source in any streaming software. Then, with a simple drag and drop, you can drop your favorite apps, like Spotify or Discord, into one of four audio streams (Game, Chat, AUX, and Media). You can choose from a variety of presets that you can then customize as needed. With the Alias ​​Pro microphone, you get an XLR Stream Mixer that lets you convert a professional XLR signal into a stream. You connect the SteelSeries Alias ​​Pro microphone to the Stream Mixer via an XLR cable, and you can then connect the station to up to two PCs simultaneously via USB-C. The right joystick and right button are also fully mappable.

descriptions: The Xerox C235DNI color laser printer with four functions (print, fax, copy, scan) combines fast printing, high reliability and easy document management, making it an ideal choice for small and medium-sized businesses or home offices. The printer enables automatic duplex printing (600 × 600 DPI) at a speed of up to 22 pages per minute, while it can print up to 30,000 pages per month. In addition to the classic wired connection via USB or RJ-45 (LAN) connector, you can also use the WiFi interface with Apple AirPrint, Mopria and WiFi Direct functions, which allow you to print wirelessly directly from mobile devices, laptops, tablets and other devices. The printer also features an automatic document feeder, a 250-sheet main paper tray, and a 2.8-inch color touchscreen. The C235DNI also features a built-in fax with a maximum transmission speed of 33.6 kbps. You will also appreciate the advanced security features that protect your sensitive data and documents from cyber threats and misuse. The printer's recommended monthly print volume is 1,500 pages.
Key features of the Xerox C235DNI multifunction laser printer

• Color multifunction printer allows printing, faxing, scanning and copying
  • Automatic two-sided printing with 250-sheet paper tray
  • Print speed reaches up to 22 pages per minute
  • Wireless WiFi connection with Apple AirPrint, Mopria and WiFi Direct
  • Supports Adobe PostScript 3 and PCL 5/6 printing languages
  • Possibility of wired connection using RJ-45 connector or USB port
  • Automatic single-sided feeder for up to 50 sheets (for scanning and copying)
  • Easy operation via color touch display
  • The Xerox C235DNI printer can be connected to the Xerox Easy Assist mobile app
